_doc: Generic pose_gate phase → researcher next action. Not e01-specific; add phases as motor gains modes.

uncrossing_height.summary: Late pose still has stacked knee height (dy too high).
uncrossing_height.next: Lengthen uncross phase in tracks (more frames before lateral apart). Do not only increase apart-dx.

need_lateral_apart.summary: Knees closer in height but not wide enough (dx short).
need_lateral_apart.next: Slightly raise apart-dx or strengthen lateral segment; keep uncross timing.

still_crossed_or_kick.summary: Late pose looks crossed, kick, or collapsed trajectory.
still_crossed_or_kick.next: Check track END preview (lime). Reduce aggressive lateral; verify start joints on-body.

open.next: Confirm ok/pose_pass; if pass → multi-seed L3 then motor ship path.

early_drift.summary: Early frames leave start pose too fast / identity drift risk.
early_drift.next: Hold start longer in tracks; shorten total motion amplitude.

unknown.next: Open gate JSON + compare track END vs video last frame.
